quests.title: Cottage Herbs
quests.description: Old Nell by the cottage wants a word once you've chosen a starter.
lines: Ah, a new keeper! My garden herbs soothe tired Harmons.
Take a Super Salve — and come back if the road gets rough.
done_lines: The herbs are growing fine. Travel safe!

quests.title: Pondside Favor
quests.description: Bring a Fishing Rod to the pondside villager.
lines: You have a rod? Wonderful!
The still ponds north of town hide gentle water Harmons. Take these capsules.
done_lines: Cast often — patience is a keeper's virtue.
incomplete_lines: If you find a Fishing Rod on Route 1, show it to me.

quests.title: Fern Friend
quests.description: Catch a Fernkit and report to the meadow naturalist.
lines: You caught a Fernkit! The meadows thank you.
Here's a Repel Charm — wild crowds can wait.
done_lines: Fernkit still thrive when keepers care.
incomplete_lines: Catch a Fernkit in the tall grass, then come back.

quests.title: Rival Wager
quests.description: Defeat Rival Sabo in the Echowood, then claim the wager.
lines: You actually beat Sabo? Ha!
I bet against him. Take the Power Band — you've earned the bragging rights.
incomplete_lines: Beat Rival Sabo up the path, then we'll settle the wager.

quests.title: Dune Samples
quests.description: Catch a Cactling for the dune researcher.
lines: A Cactling! Perfect specimen.
Take these Great Capsules for the deeper dunes.
incomplete_lines: Find a Cactling in Scorch Route brush and bring word.

quests.title: Vine Courier
quests.description: Deliver a Heart Salve to the trail medic in Verdant Route 2.
lines: You brought a Heart Salve — thank you!
Take this Super Salve and spare capsules for the grove ahead.
incomplete_lines: I need one Heart Salve for a injured scout. Can you spare one?

quests.title: Shell Song
quests.description: Catch a Shellby for the beachcomber.
lines: Shellby's song matches the tide — beautiful!
Take Ultra Capsules. Deep water hides rarer voices.
done_lines: Listen to the surf — it remembers.
incomplete_lines: Catch a Shellby in the sea scrub, then return.

quests.title: Cove Stock
quests.description: Talk to the dock clerk after reaching Saltwind Cove.
lines: Keepers who reach the Cove get a care package.
Storms north don't wait for the unprepared.

quests.title: Static Study
quests.description: Catch a Sparklit for the marsh scholar.
lines: Sparklit data — excellent!
Accept this Thunder Sigil as thanks from the storm watch.
done_lines: The marsh still crackles with secrets.
incomplete_lines: Catch a Sparklit in the Voltmarsh fens.

quests.title: Dream Ledger
quests.description: Speak with the hollow seer after earning the Charge Sigil.
lines: Your mind already brushes the Reach.
Take the Mind Sigil — a reminder to trust your Harmons.

quests.title: Barrow Vigil
quests.description: Survive the factions' final stand, then speak with the vigil keeper.
lines: You faced all three banners... and still stand.
A Chorus Shard for the keeper who would wake the dream.
done_lines: The tombs are quiet — for now.
incomplete_lines: The factions block the processional. Return when you've faced them.

quests.title: Moss Catalog
quests.description: Catch a Mossling for the Route 1 archivist (optional side task).
lines: A Mossling for the Archive — logged!
Here's a spare Great Capsule for your next find.
incomplete_lines: Catch a Mossling somewhere in the early routes.
